ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import fileName from dwl::report output application/java --- vars.ctx ++ { fileName: fileName(vars.ctx.entityCode, vars.ctx.reportType, vars.ctx.reportDate, vars.ctx.sequenceNumber, ".csv"), summaryFileName: fileName(vars.ctx.entityCode, vars.ctx.reportType, vars.ctx.reportDate, vars.ctx.sequenceNumber, "_summary.html") }

set-variable.doc:name: call summary
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { path: '/flags/summary', query: { periodStart: vars.ctx.periodStart, periodEnd: vars.ctx.periodEnd, mode: vars.flagMode, runId: vars.flagRunId default '' } }]

logger.doc:name: Log expected
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'runId=' ++ vars.runId ++ ' period=' ++ vars.ctx.periodStart ++ '..' ++ vars.ctx.periodEnd ++ ' expected records=' ++ (vars.expected.recordCount as String) ++ ' total=' ++ (vars.expected.totalAmount as String)]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- ceil((vars.expected.recordCount default 0) / (p('flags.pageSize') as Number)) + 1

set-variable.doc:name: call page

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import recordIssues, detailLine from dwl::report output application/java var page = payload var issues = (page.records default []) map recordIssues($, vars.ctx.currency, p('report.maxAmount') as Number, p('report.missingCustomerPolicy')) var lines = (page.records default []) map ((r, i) -> detailLine(r, vars.ext.serial + i + 1)) --- // map/flatMap always return a list (selectors on an empty list return null) { errors: issues flatMap ($.errors default []), warnings: issues flatMap ($.warnings default []), count: page.count default 0, amount: sum((page.records default []) map ($.amount default 0)) default 0, customers: ((page.records default []) reduce ((r, acc = {}) -> acc ++ { (r.customerId): true })) default {}, text: if (isEmpty(lines)) "" else (lines joinBy "\n") ++ "\n", lines: lines, hasMore: page.hasMore, next: page.nextCursor }

raise-error.doc:name: Fail run (NS 10)
raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- sizeOf(vars.pageOut.errors) as String ++ ' record(s) cannot be rendered safely: ' ++ ((vars.pageOut.errors[0 to (min([sizeOf(vars.pageOut.errors), 5]) - 1)]) joinBy '; ')]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var o = vars.pageOut var room = 200 - sizeOf(vars.ext.preview) --- { more: o.hasMore, serial: vars.ext.serial + o.count, total: vars.ext.total + o.amount, customers: vars.ext.customers ++ o.customers, warnings: vars.ext.warnings ++ o.warnings, preview: vars.ext.preview ++ (if (room > 0 and not isEmpty(o.lines)) o.lines[0 to (min([room, sizeOf(o.lines)]) - 1)] else []), cursor: o.next default vars.ext.cursor }

logger.doc:name: Log page
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'runId=' ++ vars.runId ++ ' page records=' ++ (vars.pageOut.count as String) ++ ' extracted so far=' ++ (vars.ext.serial as String)]

raise-error.doc:name: Fail before any report is issued
raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'Extracted ' ++ write(vars.completeness.extracted, 'application/json', {indent:false}) ++ ' but the independent aggregate is ' ++ write(vars.completeness.expected, 'application/json', {indent:false})]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import headerLine, trailerLine, sha256Text from dwl::report output application/java var detailChecksum = sha256Text(vars.detailText) var count = vars.ext.serial var header = headerLine(vars.ctx) var trailer = trailerLine({ recordCount: count, totalAmount: vars.ext.total, customerCount: sizeOf(keysOf(vars.ext.customers)), generatedAt: vars.ctx.generatedAt, detailChecksum: detailChecksum }) --- vars.ctx ++ { recordCount: count, totalAmount: vars.ext.total, customerCount: sizeOf(keysOf(vars.ext.customers)), isNil: count == 0, byFlag: vars.expected.byFlag default [], warnings: vars.ext.warnings, previewLines: vars.ext.preview, detailChecksum: if (count == 0) "NIL_REPORT" else detailChecksum, fileText: header ++ "\n" ++ vars.detailText ++ trailer ++ "\n" }
%dw 2.0 import sha256Text from dwl::report output application/java --- (vars.ctx - "fileText") ++ { fileChecksum: sha256Text(vars.ctx.fileText) }

logger.doc:name: Log built
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'runId=' ++ vars.runId ++ ' built ' ++ vars.ctx.fileName ++ ' records=' ++ (vars.ctx.recordCount as String) ++ ' sha256=' ++ vars.ctx.fileChecksum]
